Name: Transcribe audio
Description: Optional multi-input transcription, loopback capture, timestamped TXT files, English translation and standard speaker labels. Uses the Base model already included with the game app.

Name: Whisper Medium
Description: A middle-size transcription and English translation model, between Base and Large-v3. Works on CPU or with optional NVIDIA support.

Name: Whisper Large-v3
Description: Higher-quality transcription and English translation. Works on CPU; add NVIDIA support for faster processing. Uses more memory than Base.

Name: Nemotron-3 speakers
Description: An alternative speaker model, with up to eight speakers per input. Includes its CPU engine; NVIDIA support is a separate optional download. Speaker labels remain estimates.

Name: NVIDIA GPU support
Description: Speeds up Whisper and optional Nemotron on a compatible NVIDIA GPU. Requires a CUDA 13-capable NVIDIA driver. Includes app-local runtimes; it does not install or change your driver.
